reconciled_findings.legacy_call_order: Drainage is evaluated before SoilWater(2) inside each retry/substep; SoilWater(3) then recalculates groundwater level from the accepted hydraulic state for the next step.
reconciled_findings.current_serialized_runtime: Drainage response is evaluated from hydraulic_start%groundwater_level before each Richards advance, but the accepted candidate currently republishes solve_result%candidate_state%groundwater_level from the incoming state; HeadCalc does not recalculate it on the relevant prescribed-flux route.
reconciled_findings.fpm14_scope: F-PM14/F-VQ73/F-CI61 qualified drainage response physics, transactionality, mass booking, restart and per-level dq/dgroundwater_level, but did not qualify hydraulic-state-to-groundwater-level refresh semantics.
reconciled_findings.directional_service_gap: F-KT21 currently supports incoming pressure/water/ponding direction and direct bottom-control direction only. It assumes b110_source_sink_provider_t is directionally constant and has no source/sink directional term in the tangent RHS.
reconciled_findings.scientific_consequence: Treating dgwl/dqbot as zero would encode the current stale-state implementation rather than the original SWAP state-update semantics and is therefore forbidden for F-GC31 admission.
